purpose: Fail-closed interface for future dry-down/rewetting empirical evidence. Conformance is necessary but not sufficient for scientific admissibility.

conditional_mass_terms.M_soil_or_mineral_receiver_NH4_N: required whenever soil/mineral contact is possible
conditional_mass_terms.M_atmospheric_loss_rewetting: required when rewetting atmospheric loss can be material or must otherwise be tightly bounded
conditional_mass_terms.other_measured_N_terms: required for any additional known receiver or loss pathway

ordering_evidence_required_for_stage_B.question: Can downstream receiver mass be distinguished from the prior continuation-to-surface-aqueous transfer?
ordering_evidence_required_for_stage_B.minimum: source attribution plus temporal resolution or another validated causal measurement sufficient to distinguish direct alternative transfer from downstream fate after aqueous arrival
ordering_evidence_required_for_stage_B.fail_closed_rule: soil/mineral uptake or atmospheric loss without ordering evidence is COMPATIBLE_BUT_NONDISCRIMINATING, not automatic refutation of M1

material_characterization_required.minimum: sufficient composition/phase evidence to state what retained residue was actually tested and to assess mapping to the ANIMO continuation state
material_characterization_required.unknown_or_unresolved_result: allowed but forces MATERIAL_MAPPING_INSUFFICIENT for Class-F unlock

mass_balance_required.identity: M_dry_retained_total_N = source_attributable_aqueous_N + downstream_receiver_or_loss_N + terminal_non_aqueous_N + other_measured_N_terms + residual
mass_balance_required.criterion: predeclared by executing study from analytical uncertainty and recovery performance

evidence_strength_rules: schema conformance is not physical validation
synthetic test cases are not empirical evidence
downstream soil/mineral or atmospheric fate after demonstrated aqueous arrival does not refute the SQ09 transfer ordering
a single-condition pass cannot establish universal ANIMO applicability
negative and inconclusive runs must remain in the evidence package
material mapping and process discrimination are separate gates
